self.disposition: 7-point checklist run inline by the orchestrator. Spec compliance: all five planned deliverables present; §5.4's 'existing callers unaffected' claim was found FALSE and corrected in the spec (§9a). Error handling: unreadable spec reports missing rather than raising. Security: no new external input; regex built from re.escape; reads confined to project_root. Test quality: round-trips against the real producers, plus a vacuity probe confirming every drift assertion fails against HEAD (4 bare assumed rows, 0 hits for either new rule). Naming: consistent with the group_i_* siblings. YAGNI: one piece of speculative tolerance (inline <a> anchor) was REMOVED rather than kept, since no producer emits it. Boundaries: producer/consumer round-trip covered. Self-review also widened scope by three files after grepping for the stale gloss - fr_basis.py, path-a-feature.md, path-b-change.md still contradicted the corrected rulebooks.

plan.disposition: external_review.py --mode iterate on the mini-plan; 9 findings accepted, 1 declined with reason (separate legacy-label branch unnecessary: the general block rule covers it, pinned by test_legacy_bold_acceptance_label_still_counts)

code.disposition: Internal code review performed inline by the orchestrator rather than via the code-reviewer subagent: this session carries an explicit standing instruction not to invoke the Agent tool unless the user asks for it, so the subagent delegation named in ADR-029 was not available. Substituted with (a) the full external code review recorded under external_code, which is the stronger independent pass, and (b) an inline diff review against the iterate spec. Findings fixed: registry pointer for the moved _scan_one_spec; false-green heading anchor; brownfield row inconsistency; three stale copies of the Basis gloss. Recorded as completed-by-substitution, not as a subagent pass.

doubt.disposition: Adversarial pass run inline (Agent tool unavailable per session instruction), biased to disprove. Executed as probes, not assertions: bold anchor vs a discussion label; heading anchor vs '### About FR-01.01 and friends'; own-line HTML anchor; _CHECKS positional indices 0-3 unchanged after appending I6; skip path returns before frs_without_criteria is called; block-termination cannot donate criteria to a later FR (an unanchored FR is reported missing, the safe direction); iterate specs are never scanned since spec_path comes only from planning/<split>/spec.md; no import cycle from group_i_rows. All held. Residual risk accepted and stated: I6 counts BULLET criteria only, so a spec stating criteria as bare prose would be reported - advisory, and no producer emits that shape.

external_code.disposition: external_review.py --mode code on the full diff. GPT returned 3 findings, ALL accepted and fixed: (1) corpus registry resolved the moved _scan_one_spec by module+attr - registry repointed; (2) heading anchor matched any heading CONTAINING an FR id, a false-green - anchor now requires the id to begin the heading, regression test added; (3) brownfield situation row disagreed with the rule above it - harmonised plus a per-row assertion. Gemini's reply degraded into unterminated reasoning and yielded no usable findings; recorded as degraded rather than counted as a clean pass.
